sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- Aditya Bhushan Singhal,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for quashing of the preliminary notification issued under Section 11 of theRight to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 proposing to acquire inter-alia the land of the petitioners comprising of token no. 19 having an area 1.1070 hectare.

entities.text:
to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. The petitioners claim that his land is non agricultural and he should be paid compensation,
accordingly.
3. Sri Aditya Bhushan Singhal, learned counsel for the respondent-Authority submits that final declaration under Section 19 has yet not been issued.

The petitioners have right to file objections Tribhuwan Singh And 9 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197163614/
1 and the same would be decided as per the procedure prescribed under Section 15 of the Act.

entities.text: Tribhuwan Singh And 9 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have already filed objections.

5. Since, final declaration has yet not been issued and the objections of the petitioners are admittedly pending, therefore, no good ground is made out to examine the validity of the preliminary notification at this stage.
6. The petition is disposed of, accordingly with liberty to the petitioners to press their objections which are stated to be pending so that the same are decided as per the procedure prescribed.
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 15.5.2024/
